sourceRefs.locator: Inv. 56.460, Description and Matières et techniques: inscription, costume, loss on 5 November 1831, wax impression in Ms. 609 fol. 63v, its rediscovery in 1857 and production of the gilt electrotype.
pp. 383–384, “The Franks and northern Gaul”: grave across the river from the fortifications, dress fastener, military symbolism, arms, ring and three horse pits.

p. 3, introduction: date of the burial, composition of the hoard, four illustrated pierced silver coins, examination after removal from the ground and the authors’ interpretation of the selection; Table II: mints and rulers, including Leo I at Constantinople and Julius Nepos at Ravenna.
Sections “Princely tombs” and “King Childeric”: selection of grave goods by the living, limits of identification by seal and the inference of a capital from a burial.

summary.de: Vater Chlodwigs. Ein Siegelring mit seinem Namen gab der reichen Bestattung in Tournai ihre geläufige Zuordnung.
summary.en: Father of Clovis. A signet bearing his name led to the usual identification of the richly furnished burial at Tournai.
